requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop NGB keyed ink bottles supporting 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield, with CMY bottle size supporting >8K yield.
requirements.Rationale: To increase ink capacity and reduce frequency of bottle replacement, addressing customer demand for higher yield and convenience.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires modifications to IDS, bottle design, and possibly packaging.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NGB keyed bottles are developed and tested to reliably deliver 6K Black and 6K CMY page yields (with CMY >8K possible), verified by page yield tests.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability in Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure new ink bottles and refilling system provide spill-free reliability during user operation.
requirements.Rationale: Spill-free operation is critical to user satisfaction and competitive differentiation, especially for CISS systems.
requirements.Dependencies: Design of bottle, nozzle, and tank interface; compatibility with existing mechanisms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spills occur during standard user refilling in 100% of test cases.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F (Non-Original Authentication-Feature) with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label for enhanced security and authentication.
requirements.Rationale: To prevent counterfeiting and ensure only genuine HP supplies are used, protecting revenue and brand integrity.
requirements.Dependencies: Coordination with NOA-F component supplier and bottle design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F feature with metal foiled labyrinth and lid label is validated for all new bottles in pilot production.

requirements.Title: Support for Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design the printer and supplies system to allow customers to replace the Printhead Assembly (PHA) and NOA-F components without service center intervention.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability, reduces downtime, and lowers total cost of ownership for users.
requirements.Dependencies: Redesign of access and mounting mechanisms for user-friendly replacement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can successfully replace PHA and NOA-F in under 10 minutes following included instructions, as verified by usability testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80k Pages
requirements.Description: The new product must support a warranty page life of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Higher warranty life increases product value and competitiveness, especially for SMB and enterprise customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Durability of core components (PHA, tank, paper path, etc.).
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes reliability tests for 80,000 pages without major failure under standard operating conditions.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Certification for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure the product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental and efficiency requirements for the PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Environmental certifications are increasingly demanded by institutional buyers and required for market access in some regions.
requirements.Dependencies: Design, materials, and energy consumption must align with certification criteria.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product achieves EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel certification prior to launch.

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Redesign for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Redesign input and output trays to accommodate tank protrusion and optimize overall size.
requirements.Rationale: Physical integration of larger tanks requires mechanical redesign to ensure usability and compact footprint.
requirements.Dependencies: Final tank and chassis design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays operate smoothly and printer maintains acceptable size despite tank protrusion, as verified by form/fit/function testing.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) into the new printer for enhanced user interface.
requirements.Rationale: Larger, color displays improve usability, support advanced features, and align with market expectations.
requirements.Dependencies: Electrical and mechanical design changes; UI software updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD display is fully functional, passes usability and reliability tests, and supports all required UI features.

requirements.Title: New Tube Routing and Integration for 4-Tube Platform
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes and develop new tube routing and integration for a 4-tube CISS platform.
requirements.Rationale: To support new tank and ink delivery requirements, ensuring reliability and print quality.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank, carriage, and service station design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tube routing supports required ink flow, passes stress and durability tests, and integrates with new tank and carriage.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management Redesign
requirements.Description: Redesign service station aerosol management to accommodate changes from the new tank platform.
requirements.Rationale: To prevent contamination and ensure reliable long-term operation with increased ink volumes.
requirements.Dependencies: Service station and tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol management system passes internal contamination and air quality tests under all operating conditions.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Upgrade for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Upgrade the paper path to support the increased page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Higher duty cycle requires more robust paper handling to avoid jams and wear.
requirements.Dependencies: Component durability and material selection.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path operates reliably for 80,000 pages in accelerated life testing.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part Post-80k Pages
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance components to be serviceable at service centers after 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Enables extended product life and reduces total cost of ownership for high-volume users.
requirements.Dependencies: Component modularity and accessibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service centers can replace ink maintenance parts post-80k pages in under 30 minutes.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and fluidic interconnect (FI) connection in the IDS (Ink Delivery System), leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: To support new bottle/keying system and ensure secure, reliable ink connections.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS design, bottle/key interface, and LOI SHAID integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS passes all connection, leak, and reliability tests, and supports new keyed bottles.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new startup algorithm and air management system for the IDS to ensure reliable operation with the new tank and bottle system.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents startup failures and ensures consistent print quality from first use.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS hardware and firmware development.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup algorithm initializes system reliably in 100% of test cases, and air management prevents air lock or ink starvation.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality (PQ) Goals and Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Define and achieve new print quality (PQ) goals and ink depletion metrics to align with higher yield and page life targets.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures product delivers consistent quality throughout its extended life and meets new performance benchmarks.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink, IDS, and firmware updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ goals and depletion metrics are documented, tested, and met in all relevant test scenarios.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Hi PDL Components
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Marconi Hi PDL hardware and firmware components where possible to reduce development time and cost.
requirements.Rationale: Speeds time to market and reduces engineering investment.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility of legacy components with new system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All reused components pass integration and reliability tests in the new product context.

requirements.Title: Integration of Stingray Wi-Fi Module and Dune Firmware
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module and Dune firmware for connectivity and device management.
requirements.Rationale: Modern connectivity and device management features are essential for enterprise and SMB markets.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware and hardware integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi module and firmware operate seamlessly and pass all connectivity and security tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW) Implementation
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx hardware and firmware security features to protect device and data.
requirements.Rationale: Security is critical for enterprise and SMB customers, and to meet compliance requirements.
requirements.Dependencies: Hardware and firmware readiness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Security features pass internal and external security audits and penetration testing.

requirements.Title: Business Model Support for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise
requirements.Description: Design product and solution stack to support Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise business models, including PaaS and WorkFromHome/Flexworker services.
requirements.Rationale: Expands addressable market and aligns with HP’s strategic intent to protect and grow share across segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Software, services, and onboarding path readiness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is successfully launched and sold in all three segments with tailored onboarding and service options.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution and SMB Manageability Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced scan solutions and SMB manageability features, including support for WJA, HPSM, and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances product value for SMB and enterprise customers and supports managed print services.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware and software development.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Scan and manageability features are available and functional in SMB/Enterprise configurations.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Support for HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD
requirements.Description: Ensure full compatibility with HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: Critical for broad deployment and ease of use across customer environments.
requirements.Dependencies: Driver and client software updates as needed.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients and drivers are tested and certified for use with the new product.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Pages (Constraint)
requirements.Description: Maintain SuperAmp Printhead Assembly (PHA) life at 65,000 pages as a fixed constraint.
requirements.Rationale: Sets a design limit for component durability and replacement cycles.
requirements.Dependencies: Printhead design and testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA reliably operates for 65,000 pages in accelerated life testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years (Optimized)
requirements.Description: Design the product to meet a 2-year warranty life.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with industry standards and customer expectations for reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Component selection and reliability engineering.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes all reliability and quality tests for a 2-year warranty period.

requirements.Title: Throughput of 25/20 ppm (PDL)
requirements.Description: Achieve print throughput of 25 pages per minute (ppm) for standard and 20 ppm for PDL (Page Description Language) mode.
requirements.Rationale: Meets market requirements for speed and productivity.
requirements.Dependencies: Print engine performance and firmware optimization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product achieves specified throughput in benchmark tests for both standard and PDL modes.

requirements.Title: Serviceability of Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Ensure the maintenance box is easily serviceable to optimize uptime and reduce service costs.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience and lowers total cost of ownership.
requirements.Dependencies: Maintenance box design and accessibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced in under 5 minutes by a trained technician or user.
